title: typealias for Closure Types
hints: Name the function type once with `typealias`, then store several closures in a global array — Swift 6 will want that function type to be `@Sendable`.
Each validator returns `String?`; the first non-nil message wins.
jsBridge: A `typealias` for closure types is TS's `type Validator = (s: string) => string | null`. In Swift 6, storing closures in globals requires `@Sendable`, because globals are shared across threads.
